description: This file contains unit tests for the PatientProgramValidator class within the OpenMRS project. It verifies validation logic for the PatientProgram entity, including checks for null fields, date consistency, duplicate states, and program workflow conditions.

classes.name: PatientProgramValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the PatientProgramValidator's validation logic in various scenarios.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThePatientFieldIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the patient field in PatientProgram is blank.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfObjIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to validate method throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyPatientStateHasAnEndDateBeforeItsStartDate
methods.description: Checks validation error when a patient state has an end date before its start date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsMoreThanOnePatientStateWithTheSameStatesAndStartDates
methods.description: Tests detection of duplicate patient states with same start dates.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyPatientStateHasANullWorkFlowState
methods.description: Verifies validation error when a patient state lacks an associated workflow state.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheProgramPropertyIsNull
methods.description: Checks that a patient program with null program property is invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnyPatientStatesOverlapEachOtherInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Tests validation error for overlapping patient states in the same workflow.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForAValidProgram
methods.description: Ensures validation passes for a correctly configured patient program.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAPatientProgramHasDuplicateStatesInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Detects duplicate states within the same workflow.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAPatientStateHasAnInvalidWorkFlowState
methods.description: Tests error when a patient state references an invalid workflow state.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAPatientIsInMultipleStatesInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Checks that a patient cannot be in multiple states of the same workflow simultaneously.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAPatientIsInMultipleStatesInDifferentWorkFlows
methods.description: Verifies that a patient can be in multiple states across different workflows.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfTheStartDateOfTheFirstPatientStateInTheWorkFlowIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if the initial state has null start date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassForPatientStatesThatHaveTheSameStartDatesInTheSameWorkFlow
methods.description: Checks that patient states with identical start dates in the same workflow are valid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThereIsMoreThanOneStateWithANullStartDateInTheSameWorkflow
methods.description: Tests detection of multiple states with null start dates within the same workflow.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailIfPatientStateIsInRetiredWorkflow
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if the workflow is retired.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEndDateComesBeforeItsEnrolledDate
methods.description: Validates that the program's end date cannot be before its enrollment date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEnrolledDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Checks that the enrolled date is not set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEndDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Validates that the end date cannot be in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientProgramEnrollDateIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that missing enrollment date causes validation failure.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that the validation passes when string fields are within correct length.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when string fields exceed maximum length.
